title: Disentangling QAOA: From Weakly Entangled Circuits to a Classical QUBO Solver
summary: The role of entanglement in quantum optimization remains actively debated. To address this question, we focus on the fixed-parameter expanding-depth regime of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA), where a compact two-parameter schedule is trained once on small instances and then applied as the problem size and circuit depth increase. To probe this regime beyond full state-vector simulation, we perform approximate matrix product state simulations for up to 50 qubits and 100 layers and quantify entanglement by the bond dimension.
